method: Compile and execute both Python fences extracted from the lesson; SQLite checks concurrent stable-action replay and conflicting arguments. Scripted client checks bounded tool-result pairing, errors, stop reasons and round caps. Follow-up regressions cover empty end_turn, duplicate IDs with a dispatch counter, and missing/non-string/blank IDs at both loop and fill boundaries. Static assertions check current Anthropic source claims and evidence links.

observations.model: offline Python fixtures and scripted client
checks: duplicate tool IDs are rejected before dispatch and side effects
missing, non-string, empty, and whitespace-only IDs fail closed at loop and fill boundaries

limitations: The 2026-10-08 DeepSeek stdout summaries lack raw requests, responses, sample mapping and scorer; their denominators and reported model behavior could not be independently reproduced.
No live provider, API transport, production database, distributed idempotency store, downstream payment/message receiver or cross-system failure window was exercised.
SQLite verifies only a single local database transaction; it does not prove exactly-once effects across systems.
Official documentation review applies to the named Anthropic Messages API and Stripe API behavior; it does not establish a universal provider contract.
The empty-end_turn recovery text reflects current Anthropic documentation only; the offline fixture returns a state to the caller and does not test a live recovery prompt or current SDK behavior.
